title: An Act to Provide Funding to Maintain All-terrain Vehicle Trails

summary.text: This bill requires that a percentage of funds collected from all-terrain vehicle registration fees under current law be allocated to the municipality or unorganized territory of the all-terrain vehicle owner's address as shown on the owner's registration certificate for the purpose of maintaining all-terrain vehicle trails located within that municipality or unorganized territory.
